categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. primarily engages in gold and non-ferrous metal exploration, mining, beneficiation, smelting, and sales. The company also produces and sells gold mining equipment, construction materials, and investment gold bars and silver ingots. Its operations include gold mining both domestically in China and internationally in countries such as Argentina, Ghana, and Namibia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mechanized and automated mining equipment with advanced beneficiation and smelting technologies. It emphasizes intelligent mining systems, including deep vertical shaft construction and intelligent support technologies. R&D focuses on intelligent underground mining, large-scale paste filling, difficult beneficiation, optical-electrical pre-sorting of gold ore, and deep exploration technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international gold buyers, commodity exchanges such as the Shanghai Gold Exchange, and industrial users of precious metals. The company serves the gold investment market with products like standard gold bars and investment gold bars, as well as industrial and jewelry sectors. Major markets are China and overseas mining regions in South America and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span multiple provinces in China including Shandong, Fujian, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Xinjiang, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Qinghai, and Yunnan. Internationally, the company operates mines in Argentina, Ghana, Namibia, and Canada. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and other global locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Gold operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the gold supply chain, including exploration, mining, beneficiation, and smelting. It also engages in downstream activities such as production of investment gold bars and precious metal products, as well as financial investment and asset management related to precious metals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development with a focus on digital intelligence empowerment and efficiency enhancement. R&D efforts target intelligent mining technologies, deep mining, beneficiation innovations, and green mining practices. It actively participates in national and provincial key research projects and emphasizes sustainable and green mining development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of self-produced gold, externally purchased gold, small gold bars, and other precious metal products. The company also earns income from mining services, equipment sales, and financial investments. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and transfer of control to customers, with some products sold via commodity exchanges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shandong Gold is one of China's leading gold producers with a significant share of domestic gold production (about 15.47% of national mine gold output). It competes with other large domestic and international gold mining companies, maintaining a leading position through resource acquisition, technological innovation, and operational efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 82.52 billion, a 39.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.95 billion, up 26.80%. Total assets reached RMB 160.66 billion, growing 19.36%. The company has shown strong growth in production, revenue, and profitability, supported by increased gold output and resource reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shandong Gold emphasizes its rich gold resource reserves, advanced intelligent mining technologies, and integrated mining and smelting capabilities. It differentiates itself through scale, technological leadership in deep and complex mining, sustainable green mining practices, and a comprehensive product portfolio including investment-grade gold products. The company also highlights its strong governance, risk management, and commitment to social responsibility.
